title: Prepending a good item preserves bad-event probability
statement: Let a target Boolean function, an output type, a fixed head item, and a learning program returning a list of such items be given. If the head item does not satisfy a specified bad predicate, then the outer probability that the mapped program's output list contains any bad item equals the outer probability that the original program's output list contains any bad item.
hypotheses_covered: A learning program returning a list of items
The head item does not satisfy the predicate
